purpose: Freeze cross-asset stable research-question identities and implementation priority without promoting capabilities.
invariants: R is a typed machine decomposition/context for P.capital, not a fourth human world.
Research state is multidimensional; scalar Force/PNX/macro scores are not canonical.
Lower-level truth does not imply higher-level authorization.
Asset form is not pricing model.
Xs is Structural Asymmetry Source; Value Control Point is an equity-specialized implementation.
Target price and recommended position size are outside Research OS authority.

candidates.name: Regime Causal Decomposition
candidates.stable_question: What causal capital regime currently governs discount rates, risk appetite, funding conditions and cross-asset capital allocation?
candidates.hard_boundary: R is not a fourth human world; no single yield level or scalar macro score can define the regime.

candidates.name: Price-Implied Expectations
candidates.stable_question: What future state or operating assumptions are already embedded in current price?
candidates.hard_boundary: Target price and upside percentage are not canonical outputs.

candidates.name: Structural Asymmetry Source Mapper
candidates.stable_question: Why can value, scarcity, duration, carry, volatility or risk become disproportionately concentrated in this research target?
candidates.hard_boundary: Value Control Point is an equity-specialized implementation, not the universal ontology of Xs.

candidates.name: Narrative / Expectation Regime
candidates.stable_question: Which future assumption is the market currently paying for, and how is that expectation diffusing, crowding or weakening?
candidates.hard_boundary: Narrative strength is not truth; N authority is routed by pricing archetype.

candidates.name: Expectation Regime Break Detector
candidates.stable_question: Has the market's dominant future assumption begun to fracture?
candidates.hard_boundary: A break triggers bounded V/Xa/Xp re-underwriting; it is not an automatic sell signal.

candidates.name: Conditional Tail State
candidates.stable_question: How are conditional right- and left-tail states changing under the current reality/expectation regime?
candidates.hard_boundary: Xa is not issuer quality and not a fake precision probability-of-being-right score.

candidates.name: Payoff Geometry
candidates.stable_question: How does the chosen instrument convert the underlying distribution into investor payoff?
candidates.hard_boundary: Underlying right-tail potential does not imply attractive instrument payoff.

candidates.name: Portfolio Survival Gate
candidates.stable_question: If the thesis is wrong or correlations jump, does the portfolio retain the right to continue compounding?
candidates.hard_boundary: Issuer durability and stop-loss rules are not definitions of portfolio survival.

candidates.name: Internal vs External Rotation Detector
candidates.stable_question: Is capital rotating within a theme/asset class or leaving the risk complex entirely?
candidates.hard_boundary: Within-theme diversification is not diversification during external de-risking.

candidates.name: Two-Stage Asset / Pricing Router
candidates.stable_question: What is the asset form, which pricing archetype is binding, and which model family should be called?
candidates.hard_boundary: Asset form is not pricing model; routing follows dominant pricing mechanism, not sector name.

candidates.name: Reality State Transition
candidates.stable_question: Is the relevant capital or asset-specific reality actually changing?
candidates.hard_boundary: Attention and price appreciation do not establish P.

candidates.name: Evidence Authority Graph
candidates.stable_question: What is known, inferred or merely claimed, and what would falsify each material claim?
candidates.hard_boundary: Practitioner claims generate hypotheses but do not self-promote to empirical evidence.
